desks.title: Data integrity

economic_state.claim: Palimpsest abstains from a broad state-of-economy direction: current public coverage is uneven and no validated composite model has crossed the gate.
prohibited_interpretations: No metric is an estimate of true GDP.
Temporal order is not a causal or leading-indicator claim.
Not collected is not zero and source silence is not economic contraction.

input_integrity.detail: All 15 same-period wide metrics match the bitemporal ledger.
Southbound flow is HKD; northbound turnover is CNY; no cross-currency sum is formed.

method: Deterministic no-network join using release and collection clocks, latest-as-of revision selection, source-independence groups, explicit units, and abstention gates.

readiness.abstention_reason: Coverage and revision history do not yet support a broad state-of-economy composite.
